150,000 humans permanently stop existing every day from what are basically engineering problems with meat robots. 6,650 diseases have zero FDA-approved treatments. At the current discovery rate, testing everything takes 443 years. Everyone currently alive will be dead by then.

Your chance of dying from terrorism: 1 in 30 million. Your chance of dying from disease: 100%. If cancer had oil reserves, you would have cured it by 2003. Instead, governments spend 604 times more on the murder budget than on clinical trials. This is mathematically stupid.

This book contains the exact sequence of legal bribes required to redirect 1% of the murder budget to the medicine budget. If you follow the instructions, you'll increase the rate of clinical trials by 12.3x, compress the timeline from 443 years to 36, and prevent 10.7 billion deaths.

The best part: nobody has to become a better person. You just point everyone's greed at diseases instead of each other. It's like weaning a baby off eating paint chips. You can't just take away all the paint chips at once. They'll cry. You have to gradually replace them with food until they forget paint chips were ever an option.

The universe is literally offering you infinite money and eternal life, and you're thinking about it.

This is why aliens don't visit.

Love, 
Wishonia

P.S. You named your planet dirt.
